Force generation at Endor system may not be canceled. Unless Leave Them To Me on table, opponent's combat vehicles, Dark Jedi, [Maintenance] cards, and [Permanent Weapon] cards are deploy +2 to Rebel Cell sites. Opponent generates no Force at Hidden Landing Site. [Immune to Alter]”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=10 Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"; copy re-made 20 April 2010, first printing not found), page 10, slip 91E. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=10 Internet Archive]</ref> Document: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-91E-Uncharted_Settlements.png]]) prints slip number “91E” bottom right.

Organized Attack, S-foils, Revolution, Your Destiny (unless you chose Rebel/Rebel Starship), and [Virtual Block 4] Ellors Madak are canceled. You may not deploy operatives or [Maintenance] cards. Unless Leave Them To Me on table, opponent's combat vehicles, Dark Jedi, [Maintenance] cards, and [Permanent Weapon] cards are deploy +2 to Rebel Cell sites. Opponent generates no Force at Hidden Landing Site. (Immune to Alter.)(Errata Text - September 9th, 2009)”<ref name="cl-1240_91-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001437/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111144021/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of March to May 2013 carry no game text</ref> The PC website card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so its wording follows that data; it is listed as a version because the PC published it.

Opponent generates no Force at Hidden Landing Site. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' the PC card image prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word, after the PC website card list (PC-E1) had published a different text. It is listed as its own version, placed at its upload date (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date (here its server upload date), even when its words repeat an earlier version; whatever was published last is current). The date is only the folder's bulk upload date: the image may have been made earlier, so its place in the order is uncertain, but the versioning order follows the upload date. Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and the Virtual Block 4 set mark) and prints the number “92E” bottom right (the release-sheet slip has “91E”); its caption bottom left reads “•Path Of Least Resistance & •Revealed (V)”, the label of another card.
